list.title: Purchases
list.empty: There are no purchases with these filters.

new.title: New purchase
new.intro: Choose the supplier and the date on the invoice. Lines are captured afterwards.
new.supplierRequired: Choose the supplier on the invoice.

detail.title: Purchase {{folio}}
detail.declaredHint: Optional. If it doesn't match the lines we'll tell you, and the purchase is confirmed anyway.
detail.entryConfirmed: The goods already came in with {{folio}}
detail.sealed: This purchase is confirmed: only the reception, invoice and notes can be edited.

totals.mismatch: The invoice total does not match the sum of the lines: {{difference}}.
totals.quantityVariance: Some line invoices more than what was received on the order. The purchase confirms anyway; check the quantity.

lines.catalogCostOtherBase: The catalog cost is in the other basis (with or without tax) and is not preloaded: enter it as it appears on the paper.
lines.title: Products on the invoice
lines.empty: You haven't added any products yet.
lines.lotHint: This product is tracked by lot: the inventory entry will ask for it.
lines.notPurchasable: That presentation isn't marked as purchasable, but you can still use it.

charges.title: Additional charges
charges.intro: Freight, handling or insurance. They add to the invoice total and don't change product costs.

confirmDialog.title: Confirm {{folio}}
confirmDialog.body: On confirming, the lines and amounts are sealed and the cost without tax is frozen. Afterwards you'll be able to add the goods to inventory.

cancelDialog.title: Cancel {{folio}}
cancelDialog.body: The purchase stops counting and, if you already opened its inventory entry as a draft, that is canceled too. Write the reason: it stays in the history.
